svg.title: Observed training loss, development loss and learning rate

cc:Work.dc:title: Observed training loss, development loss and learning rate
cc:Work.dc:description: Original run: 892 training records; its development loss is observed only at updates 100–800. No endpoint dev-loss point is invented. Loss is not generation WER. Raw losses and explicitly labeled trailing means are both shown; learning-rate values are logged observations.
